**The problem:** `slugify` in `src/slugify.py` replaced every non-alphanumeric character with its own dash. So `"  a   b  "` became `a---b`, and `"C++ rocks!"` became `c---rocks-`.

**The fix:** I changed the regex to `[^a-z0-9]+`, which collapses each run of such characters into a single dash. I also added `.strip("-")` to remove leading and trailing dashes:

```python
return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")
```
